name: ed-interviews-sim
description: Dev-only simulation of a whole hiring round through the real UI. Never shipped; the tool itself still has no build step and no dependencies.

scripts.test: node scenarios.mjs && node foundations.mjs && node editors.mjs && node stages.mjs && node applicants.mjs && node notices.mjs && node e2e.mjs && node score.mjs && node auth.mjs && node fuzz.mjs 40
scripts.stress: bash make-site.sh && node score-stress.mjs 60 1 && node score-stress.mjs 30 1000 --latency && node score-stress.mjs 30 2000 --flaky
scripts.emulator: bash make-site.sh --emulator && ../tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.json --only auth,firestore --project mgh-ed-hiring-test-emu "node emulator.mjs"
